decisions.reason: The opex-specific source selection does not alter the general obligation to disclose assumptions or the policy for inputs that remain unavailable.
Selecting the operating-cost range does not change the site-capex assumption basis, status, or typologies.
The opex decision applies to the full network but does not alter the network count, site list, typologies, or missing-detail treatment.

The source specifies a CAD opex input but does not authorize a change to the AUD model currency or 2031 price base; the resulting currency uncertainty is already represented by the same-message ambiguity Event.
The operating-cost input change does not modify the debt/equity split, interest rate, tranche structure, or mezzanine policy.
The opex basis does not change the separately established categories or presentation of program-wide capex line items.
Changing the operating-cost input does not alter the required revenue streams or their separate modeling method.
The opex input may affect calculated payment amounts, but it does not change the sizing targets or the prohibition on a DSCR-only approach with negative equity returns.
The operating-cost range may affect model outputs but does not change the required CCA classes, depreciation treatment, or tax-shield methodology.
The revised opex basis may affect computed returns but does not alter the required equity-IRR output or its target range.
The opex input may affect calculated DSCR values but does not change the requirement to maintain a debt schedule and produce DSCR coverage output.
The operating-cost assumption applies within the model but does not change the Case F and Case G definitions, availability-payment mechanism, or comparison requirement.
